newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Feb 18 - Santa Fe - One vessel loading wheat, 1 vessel in roads, none due. Max. draft 26 ft. 10 in. at access channel. Diamante - One vessel loading maize, none in roads, 2 due. Max. draft 26 ft. 10 in. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Three vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbmp, 1 loading wheat, 1 loading sun pellets. 6 Vessels in roads, 16 due at 6 terminals during the coming week. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that the draft will not vary in the next week. Pasa Berth draft - 25 ft. 4 in. fw. Rosario - Three vessels berthed of which 1 awaiting orders, 1 loading sun pellets, 1 loading maize. 1 Vessel in roads. Max. draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Forecast indicates that draft will not vary.

Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 2 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. fw. Draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - Five vessels berthed of which 1 discharging steel products, 1 loading coils, 1 discharging iron ore, 2 discharging coal. 3 Vessels in roads, 5 due during the coming week. Draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Pedro - One vessel due. Draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel as follows at high tide, vessels up to 22 metres beam 32 ft. 00 in. fw, over 22 metres beam, 31 ft. 06 in. fw. Buenos Aires - 17 Vessels in port, 28 due during the coming week. Max. draft 31 ft. 06 in. fw high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock sud - Max. draft 29 ft. fw high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel).

Necochea - Four vessels berthed of which 3 loading wheat, 1 loading maize. 5 Vessels in roads, 5 due. Depth at zero at the access channel 37 ft. 04 in. Max. recommended sailing draft high tide, 40 ft. 0 in. with special permission of coast guard. Bahia Blanca - Five vessels berthed of which 1 loading wheat, 1 loading naphtha, 1 loading barley, 1 awaiting orders, 1 loading ethylene. 1 Vessel in roads, 6 due. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, Feb 18 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 cotton discharger, 1 granite loader, 2 cellulose loaders, 1 wheat discharger. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders, 1 petroleum discharger. Praia Mole - 2 Steel products loaders, 2 coal dischargers. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. Ubu - Iron ore loader. 16 Vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Santos Dock Co. (CODESP) personnel held a general meeting on 14/2 in which it was decided that they would hold a strike from 24/2. A meeting is scheduled to take place on 23/2 to decide whether their strike call will be maintained or not. Vessels berthed, 1 bulk diesel oil loader, 2 full containers, 2 general cargo, 2 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 2 bulk chemical products loaders, 1 sulphur discharger, 1 sugar/general cargo load, 2 general cargo/container loaders/dischargers, 1 container/bulk juice loader/discharger. 15 Vessels waiting in roads, 74 due. Cosipa - 1 Iron ore loader. Ultrafertil - 1 Fertiliser discharger.

Paranagua - Vessels berthed, 1 container discharger, 5 general cargo dischargers, 3 general cargo loaders, 1 reefer loader. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 general cargo for loading. For discharging, 8 pellets vessels, 3 soya, 1 general cargo. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 3 full container loaders, 1 chemical products discharger, 8 vessels due during next 10 days.

CHILE, Feb 17 - Arica - Three vessels working normally, 2 berths vacant, 11 vessels due during the week. Iquique - Three vessels berthed, working normally, 2 berths vacant, 10 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 1 berth available, 13 vessels due during the week for loading and discharging concentrates, bulk copper, containers, general cargo. Valparaiso - Nine vessels berthed, working normally, no berths vacant, no delays. 21 Vessels due during the week, 1 days delay expected. San Antonio - Eight vessels operating, 1 berth vacant, 15 vessels due during the week, no waiting time.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed, working normally, 3 vessels due during the week, none in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels berthed, working normally, 1 berth vacant. 7 Vessels due, 1 days berthing delay expected. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels. Steel pier - 1 Vessel due. Coronel pier - 2 Vessels in terminal, 2 due. Oil terminal - 2 Vessels in terminal, none due. Lirquen - Three vessels berthed, 3 berths vacant, 5 vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels. Puerto Montt - Two coasters berthed, 2 vessels due. Punta Arenas - Two vessels and 1 coaster berthed, 9 vessels due during the week.

PERU, Feb 17 - Callao - Seven vessels in bay, 9 in pier (general cargo/containers), no berthing delays. Paita - One fishmeal vessel in pier, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels. Talara - One vessel in bay, 1 in pier (oil), no berthing delays. Chimbote - One fishmeal vessel in bay, no berthing delays. Ilo - One fishoil vessel in pier, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, Feb 18 - Puerto Ordaz - One vessel loading iron ore, 3 due. Palua - Three vessels due. Matanzas - Six vessels loading steel products, 7 vessels due. Venalum - Two vessels loading aluminium, 2 vessels due. San Felix - One vessel loading aluminium. Punta Cuchillo - Two vessels loading refined products. La Guaira - Two vessels loading/discharging generals, 7 vessels due, 2 under repair. Puerto Cabello - 15 Vessels operating of which 12 loading/discharging generals, 3 discharging grain, 16 vessels due. Guanta - Two vessels operating of which 1 each discharging salt, barytes, 5 vessels due. Maracaibo - One vessel loading/discharging generals.

Puerto Miranda - Two vessels loading crude oil. El Tablazo - Two vessels loading urea. Buoy B71 - One vessel loading coal. Palmarejo Sur - Two vessels loading crude oil. La Salina - Two vessels loading crude oil. Bajo Grande - Two vessels loading crude oil (refined products terminal). One vessel loading gasoline at gasoline terminal. Amuay - No report received. Punta Palma, Punta Camacho, San Lorenzo, La Ceiba - No vessels in ports.
